# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

The Code of Conduct for `{serocalculator}` lives at the root of this
repository: [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

That root file is the canonical text, and the one GitHub uses for this
repository's community profile. This pointer exists so that the relative link
from [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) resolves when that file is viewed on
GitHub, where relative paths resolve against `.github/` rather than the
repository root.
